gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-labrada: Labrada reads bookish and dignified, with wide openings. Arkhip above it floats its letters apart in hairline-uniform curves, so the serif below feels like it has a pulse by comparison.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-laila: Arkhip's bowls and stems are all drawn at one weight, a geometric look that stands apart from its neighbor. Laila's serif curves feel more traditional and editorial.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-montaga: Arkhip leads with modern, geometric letters floating well apart, no swelling anywhere. Montaga handles the reading, its pen-lifted curves leaving loops unfinished like thread stitched along a path, while Arkhip does the shouting.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-new-tegomin: Dignified and traditional, the lower font draws its c like a wide-open ring. New Tegomin keeps a long page unhurried, while Arkhip's single-width strokes stay modern above it.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-podkova: Arkhip keeps its bowls free of any swelling. Podkova's broad, welcoming c gives a long stretch of text a bookish, traditional rhythm beneath it.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-rhodium-libre: Traditional brush ends lift away before the curve closes. Arkhip is best at flat, unmodulated geometry up top, while Rhodium Libre is the text serif that carries the editorial voice below.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-rokkitt: Rokkitt brings a bookish, traditional c, open like a bent paperclip. Arkhip's crossbars match its stems in thickness, and Rokkitt gives that modern geometry a classic serif foil.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-sanchez: Wide letters, wire-straight strokes. Arkhip does constant-width arms and legs best, while Sanchez, a bookish serif, opens its c like a pair of calipers and keeps things dignified.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-solway: Solway is a text serif with authoritative, bookish flatness of line. Make Arkhip small and its floating letters lose their punch, while an oversized Solway would lose its generous entry into the e.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-yuji-boku: Dignified and editorial, the text serif below holds each stroke to one thickness like a drawn cable. Arkhip is best at modern, geometric display lettering, while Yuji Boku handles the reading with a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart.
